Payers, providers, and consumer health partners build on League's platform to deliver high-engagement healthcare solutions proven to improve health outcomes. League has raised over $285 million in venture capital funding to date, powering the digital experiences for some of healthcare's most trusted brands, including Highmark Health, Manulife, Medibank, and Shoppers Drug Mart. Launch Your UX Research Career! Join our Design Research team and gain hands-on experience in identifying user needs, challenges, and opportunities. You'll learn the fundamentals of various research methods, how to transform learnings into actionable insights, and how to inform user- centered designs. Participate in conducting end-to-end research, synthesizing findings, contributing to data-driven decision- making, and exploring innovative research techniques. This co-op is your opportunity to establish a solid foundation in understanding people and crafting exceptional user experiences. Some things the Design Research team works on: • Leveraging diverse research methods to discover stakeholder needs, challenges, and opportunities • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to determine research priorities and inform product roadmaps • Supporting a democratized research practice from concept through execution, ensuring rigor and validity • Transforming qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights that drive user-centered designs Educating and empowering teams across the organization through research, learning sessions, and resources • Some of the methods we use on the Design Research team include: • Qualitative methods (e.g., interviews, moderated testing, unmoderated testing, etc.) Quantitative methods (e.g., surveys, analytics interpretation, A/B testing, etc.) • Job Requirements Your career experience so far may include: • Exposure to UX research methodologies or human-computer interaction concepts • Hands-on experience with research projects (academic or professional) • Previous co-op or internship experience in a related field A passion for understanding people and solving complex problems • As a UX Research Co-op, you are likely to assist with: • Conducting and presenting user research for our platform • Developing and facilitating workshops that help guide the design team in leveraging AI and other emerging technologies responsibly and effectively • Assisting in the design and execution of various research studies, from defining research questions to recruiting participants • Analyzing qualitative and quantitative data to identify patterns, themes, and actionable insights • Contributing to the synthesis and communication of research findings through artifacts, reports, presentations, and interactive sessions Supporting the development of educational resources and templates for research best practices • Security-related Responsibilities: • Compliance with Information Security Policies • Compliance with League's secure coding practice • Responsibility and accountability for executing League's policies and procedures Notification of HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches or policy violations • As part of your application, please record a 1-minute video answering: ? "Why do you want to work at League?" Upload your video to Google Drive or YouTube, and share the link in a clickable PDF with your application. Please note: This is an in-office position at our Toronto HQ from Monday to Thursday and Fridays are work-from-home. We really value fostering in-person connection and collaboration which is especially advantageous as learning opportunity for a Co-op student.
